scope: Candidate infrastructure for repeatable model-serving experiments and bare-metal GPU profiling. This registry records interfaces and verified capability, not prices or credentials.

profiling.note: System and timeline profiling are usable on the tested VM. Full performance-counter access was restricted; re-test on bare metal.
Provisioning is already used by the lab. Verify driver counter permissions and host controls on each pool before deep profiling.
Add credentials later, then verify root access, driver controls, Nsight Compute counters, clocks, power limits, and topology.

credentials.purpose: optional pinned region; blank enables discovery across GPU bare-metal regions
SSH key name for a user-managed cluster
optional image-specific OS login username; auto is supported by the setup wrapper
external local path to the SSH private key; never store in this repository

read_only_endpoints: GPU bare-metal flavors with capacity and prices

profiling.note: API access and GPU bare-metal catalog discovery are verified. Nsight Systems/Compute access, driver controls, clocks, power limits, and topology remain unverified until a user-managed host is created and probed.
